characters.name: Mestertyven i generaluniform

characters.look: The master thief dressed up as a grand general: the same wiry young man of about twenty-two with a sharp-featured, clever face, a pointed chin, a sly lopsided grin, a thin black moustache and short curly black hair. characters.name: Mestertyven som fillegutt
characters.description: Mestertyven i filler, så fattig og lurvete at det er helt ynkelig. Med tre levende harer i sekken lister han seg inn i gangen hos amtmannen for å stjele søndagssteken.
characters.look: The master thief disguised as a wretched beggar lad: the same wiry young man with a sharp-featured, clever face, a pointed chin, a sly lopsided grin and a thin black moustache, his cheeks smudged with dirt and his curly black hair uncombed. He wears a torn, floppy straw hat, a baggy sackcloth smock full of holes and patches tied with string, and frayed trousers rolled up to the knees, and goes barefoot, with a big patched brown sack over one shoulder.

characters.name: Mestertyven som engel
characters.description: Mestertyven med et stort, hvitt laken over seg og vingene av ei gås på ryggen. Oppe i lønna forteller han presten at han skal tas opp levende i Guds rike.
characters.look: The master thief disguised as an angel: the same wiry young man with a sharp-featured, clever face, a pointed chin, a sly lopsided grin and a thin black moustache. A big white linen bedsheet is draped over his head and body like a long hooded robe, leaving his face free, and a pair of real grey-and-white goose wings is tied onto his back with string, a little crooked. His bare feet peek out below the sheet.

characters.name: Mestertyven som gammel kjerring
characters.description: Mestertyven i et fillete skjørt og en jakke han har lånt av ei gammel kjerring, med stav i hånda og pose på ryggen. Hun fryser så fælt, og i posen har hun to lommelerker.
characters.look: The master thief disguised as a crooked old beggar woman: a stooped, limping figure leaning on a knobbly wooden stick, with a small sack on the back. A faded black headscarf is pulled low over a tangled grey wig, but a thin black moustache and a sly grin peek out underneath. He wears a borrowed ragged brown skirt that is too short, showing big muddy boots, and a patched grey wool jacket.

characters.name: Mestertyven med geiteskjegg
characters.description: Mestertyven i filler, med sot i ansiktet, parykk og et stort skjegg av geitehår, så ingen kan kjenne ham igjen. Han skal i bryllup med ei mjødtønne og må holde fingeren i hullet.
characters.look: The master thief disguised as a wretched old carter, unrecognisable: his face smeared with soot, a shaggy grey wig and a huge, bushy false beard of grey-white goat hair reaching down to his belt, with only his sly, narrow dark eyes showing. He wears a squashed, wide-brimmed black hat, a ragged mud-brown coat tied with rope, patched knee breeches and worn clogs.

characters.name: Den gamle kjerringa hos røverne
characters.description: Røvernes ufrie husholderske, som advarer fremmede, men må finne seg i røverlivet.
characters.look: A short, round old woman of about seventy with red apple cheeks, a button nose, shrewd twinkling blue eyes, deep laugh lines and wisps of white hair escaping from a red-and-white checked headscarf tied under her chin. She wears a long rust-brown homespun dress with the sleeves pushed up, a wide sunflower-yellow apron and worn leather shoes, and keeps a big wooden ladle stuck in her apron strings.

characters.name: Husmannen (faren)
characters.description: En fattig far som ikke kan gi sønnene arv, og som motvillig må be amtmannen om datteren på vegne av mestertyven.
characters.look: A thin, timid old cottager of about sixty-five with a long, droopy, worried face, big sad grey eyes under bushy brows, a red-tipped nose, sunken cheeks with grey stubble and thin grey hair sticking up in tufts. He wears a threadbare, patched mouse-brown smock tied with a cord, baggy patched breeches and old clogs, with a worn grey-and-blue striped blanket wrapped round his shoulders like a shawl.

characters.name: Bonden med oksene
characters.description: En sliten mann som skal selge oksene sine uten at den sinte kjerringa hans får vite det, og som blir lurt tre ganger på samme vei: av en sko, av noen som henger i trærne og av et brøl i skogen.
characters.look: A big, broad, soft-hearted farmer of about forty with a round, weathered face that is grey and tired, a bulbous red nose, small worried blue eyes, large ears and a short, curly light-brown beard. He wears a battered brown felt hat, a woolly sheepskin vest over a blue homespun shirt with rolled-up sleeves, brown knee breeches and muddy boots, and carries a long coiled rope over one shoulder.

characters.name: Amtmannen
characters.description: En rik og myndig mann som setter prøver for å teste mestertyven før han gir bort datteren sin.
characters.look: A stout, self-important gentleman of about fifty-five with a huge round belly, a pink double chin, rosy jowls, small twinkling eyes, a snub nose, a neat grey moustache waxed into two curly tips and grey hair curling over his ears. He wears a round-crowned black hat, a tobacco-brown frock coat with brass buttons over a canary-yellow waistcoat stretched tight across his belly, a gold watch chain, grey striped trousers and shiny black shoes.

characters.name: Presten Hr. Lars
characters.description: En selvhøytidelig prest som håner amtmannen, men blir spektakulært lurt av mestertyven.
characters.look: A tall, stiff, very proud parson of about fifty with a long thin face, a long pointed nose held high, raised eyebrows, a small pursed mouth and a long, pointed sandy-grey beard. He wears a round, wide-brimmed black hat, a long black cassock buttoned to the chin, a big white pleated millstone ruff around his neck and black buckled shoes, and clasps a small black hymn book to his chest.

characters.name: Amtmannens datter
characters.description: Amtmannens datter, som er både vakker og fin og god og snill. Henne vil mestertyven ha, og for hennes skyld klarer han alle prøvene faren hennes finner på.
characters.look: A kind, clever young woman of about twenty with a heart-shaped face, a dimple in one cheek, lively grey-green eyes that always seem to be laughing, a small straight nose and nut-brown hair in two braids coiled into round buns over her ears.
